## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector signals (Utilities, Consumer Staples, Energy, Materials, REITs showing strength) alongside broad Technology and Financials weakness, and leadership spread across multiple sectors.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead: EXC (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND, D (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MDLZ (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +8.74%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +4.46% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY. Energy showing cyclical strength: XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +10.55%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.60%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: CHTR (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.14%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND, MDLZ (1W: +5.59% | 1M: +8.74%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +19.60%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -16.76% | 1M: -19.80%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -15.16% | 1M: -14.61%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -12.10% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION, NOW (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -19.86%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +11.67%), INTC (1W: +10.21%), CME (1W: +5.63%), MDLZ (1W: +5.59%), NEM (1W: +5.29%) — strong short-term flows into semiconductors, select cyclicals and commodities. Notable divergence: PEP (1W: +4.46% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY may be short-term reversal rather than sustained trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak with CORRECTION pockets; AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND stand out, while AAPL (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND lag; NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +4.17%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Tech: 4/19 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft near-term with selective strength; CME (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +2.25%) ABOVE TREND is a standout, but major banks like JPM (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND and WFC (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND weigh on the group. Sector breadth: Financials: 5/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed defensive tone: JNJ (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +3.75%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.99% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND versus ISRG (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 6/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Energy, Materials and select Utilities and Consumer Staples names (XOM, NEM, EXC, MDLZ) while reducing exposure to extended large-cap Technology names showing multi-week weakness (AAPL, MSFT, INTU). Style mixed / no clear leadership — remain selective and let follow-through confirm rotation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +10.21% | 1M: +34.70%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -16.76% | 1M: -19.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (XOM, CVX) — Sector breadth: Energy: 8/8 positive. Materials (NEM) and Utilities (EXC, D) showing follow-through. BEARISH: Technology and Communication where multiple large caps trade below trend.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA CORRECTION for hold of its 1M support for trend resumption; AAPL BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim recent 1W lows signals further downside; XOM ABOVE TREND — sustained breakout above recent 1M highs would confirm cyclicals-led continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMD (+50): news on AI semiconductor opportunity, price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) — sentiment confirmed by strong performance. CME (+55): new futures listings, price ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.63% | 1M: +2.25%) — confirmed. BA (+60): large aircraft orders, price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +20.68%) — confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (-50): downgrade concerns, price BELOW TREND (1W: -16.76% | 1M: -19.80%) — sentiment confirmed and signals downside risk. NOW (+60) appears in bullish headlines but price BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -19.86%) — clear divergence (bullish news but distribution).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
AMD (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +17.07%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +3.75%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk: persistent Technology and large-cap Financials weakness and headline/price divergences (NOW bullish headlines vs falling price; INTU negative news confirming declines).
